plan.summary: This 4-week block builds general strength, simple explosive work, and supportive conditioning around a boxing off-camp schedule with more sparring in mind. Week 1 establishes training maxes for the main lifts so percentage work can start cleanly in Week 2. Weeks 2-3 build force and power with low exercise complexity and controlled volume, and Week 4 deloads by cutting volume while keeping movement quality high.

phaseOverview.label: Building
phaseOverview.focus: Build squat and press strength, basic jumping and throwing power, and an aerobic base without adding too much fatigue to boxing.

phaseOverview.label: Intensifying
phaseOverview.focus: Progress the main lifts and keep power work sharp while adjusting volume to sparring and recovery.

phaseOverview.label: Expressing
phaseOverview.focus: Shift toward faster and sharper output while keeping enough strength work to hold onto force qualities.
